test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Call it a day

options.text: To have the greatest day ever
To refer to something as something else

solution: The correct answer is: **To stop working**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Call it a day"** means to stop working for the day or to conclude an activity. (दिन का काम समाप्त करना) • **Example: **After working on the project for 8 hours, we decided to call it a day. Therefore, the correct answer is: **To stop working.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To have the greatest day ever** (अब तक का सबसे अच्छा दिन बिताना): To experience an exceptionally good day. • **Example:** Winning the championship made it the greatest day ever for the team. • **To be very straightforward** (बहुत स्पष्ट होना): To be direct and clear in communication. • **Example: **He is known to be very straightforward in his opinions. • **To refer to something as something else** (किसी चीज को किसी और चीज के रूप में संदर्भित करना): To call or name something by a different term. • **Example:** He often refers to his car as his baby. 3d:Tb1e, The correct answer is: **Lenient.**
